test_cases.name: Chevy Toys - Quote Request Including Unavailable Item
test_cases.description: A verbose customer request for a quote, including an item that is not available in the catalog, triggering an intervention for item availability resolution.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request: Toy Vehicles and Special Edition Train
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out from Chevy Toys to request a quote for several items we are considering for our upcoming retail promotion. We are looking to source a mix of toy vehicles and train sets, and would appreciate your assistance in providing pricing and availability details.

Specifically, please include the following in the quote:
- 10 units of the JoySprout Toy Car Set
- 5 units of the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train
- 8 units of the SmartToys Fast Car Set
- 3 units of the WonderWagon Deluxe Train (this is the special edition model with enhanced features, which we have seen referenced in industry reviews but could not locate in your catalog)

If there are any issues with availability, especially regarding the WonderWagon Deluxe Train, please let us know if there are alternative options or if you can accommodate this request through special sourcing. We are open to suggestions and would appreciate any guidance you can provide.

Best regards,
Chevy Toys

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request including unavailable item
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer requests a quote for several items, including one that is not available in the catalog, which triggers an intervention.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Product Availability and Pricing Inquiry
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out on behalf of Mr. Fresh Foods as we are currently reviewing our inventory needs for the upcoming quarter and would like to request a formal quote for a few products. We have had positive experiences with your service in the past, and I appreciate your attention to detail and prompt responses.

For our next order, could you please provide pricing and availability for the following items:

1. Organic Carrot (we are interested in a bulk quantity, so please advise on your standard pack sizes and any volume discounts available).
2. Sun-Dried Tomato Slices (we have a growing demand for this item and would like to know if you can supply it, as we did not see it listed in your most recent catalog).
3. Green Olive – 10 kg (Item No: AITEM-1003).

If you require any additional information regarding our business account or delivery preferences, please let me know. Thank you very much for your assistance, and I look forward to your detailed response.

Best regards,
Mr. Fresh Foods

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request: WonderWagon Pull-Along Train and Deluxe Track Expansion
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

I hope you're having a good day! I'm reaching out from ChevyToys because we're planning to refresh our play area and need some new products. Specifically, I'd like a quote for the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train (we've had great feedback on this one, so please include all the details you usually provide for quotes). Also, we're interested in adding the Deluxe Track Expansion set for the WonderWagon trains—I've heard from a couple of customers that this expansion really enhances the play experience, but I couldn't find it listed on your website or in the catalog. If you have any info on availability or pricing for the Deluxe Track Expansion, please include it in the quote as well.

If there are any bundle options or special deals for ordering both together, let me know. Looking forward to your reply!

Best regards,
Larry King
